description: This file defines the 'Bot' data model and related functions for managing bots in the Mattermost system, including validation, cloning, patching, and error handling.

classes.name: Bot
classes.description: Represents a bot user in the system, including metadata such as UserId, Username, DisplayName, Description, OwnerId, and timestamps.

classes.name: BotPatch
classes.description: Specifies fields that can be updated on an existing bot, such as Username, DisplayName, and Description.

classes.name: BotGetOptions
classes.description: Provides filtering options for bulk fetching of bots, including OwnerId, IncludeDeleted, OnlyOrphaned, Page, and PerPage.

classes.name: BotList
classes.description: A list of Bot pointers, representing multiple bots.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the bot's fields for auditing purposes.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Provides minimal information to identify a bot for logging.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the bot.

methods.name: IsValidCreate
methods.description: Validates the bot data before creation, checking username, display name, description, and owner ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the bot's overall correctness, including ID and timestamps.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the bot object before saving, setting timestamps and normalizing username.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates the timestamp before saving modifications.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Generates an etag string for caching based on UserId and UpdateAt.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies optional updates from a BotPatch to the bot.

methods.name: WouldPatch
methods.description: Checks if a given patch would modify the bot.

methods.name: UserFromBot
methods.description: Creates a User model from a Bot object.

methods.name: BotFromUser
methods.description: Creates a Bot object from a User model.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Computes an etag for a list of bots.

methods.name: MakeBotNotFoundError
methods.description: Creates an error indicating a bot does not exist or access is denied.

methods.name: IsBotDMChannel
methods.description: Determines if a channel is a direct message channel with a specific bot user ID.
